Souls attach to regular symbols, while Mystery reveals during Free Spins can create Spirit Orbs. If Souls are already present, Orbs can activate an Instant Bonus; a separate Pandora’s Box also depends on the number of Souls on the reels.
playn-go-hope-unleashed-fortune-rises.editorial: The game combines two parallel systems: Magic Circle Re-Spins with a growing Expanding Wild and Soul-based instant prizes. A Re-Spin chain is capped at 30, making this a distinct progression mechanic rather than endless respins.

features.title: Magic Circle
features.description: Mystery Symbols can reveal a Magic Circle, which summons Pandora Expanding Wild and triggers a Re-Spin.

features.title: Wild Multiplier and Re-Spins
features.description: Another Magic Circle continues the Re-Spins chain and can raise the Wild Multiplier up to x5; one chain is limited to 30 respins.

features.title: Souls and Spirit Orbs
features.description: Souls attach to symbols; Spirit Orbs during Free Spins can activate an Instant Bonus, while Pandora’s Box depends on the Soul count.

intro: Mayan Ritual unfolds among Mayan temples: five reels with forty lines accommodate Giant Symbols sized 2×2 and 3×3, occupying several positions at once.
A Giant Bonus Symbol replaces its occupied area with a Bonus Slot mini-slot producing multipliers and Free Spins. A pyramid Giant Wild substitutes for regular symbols.
wazdan-mayan-ritual.editorial: Mayan Ritual differs from Los Muertos through its symbol theme and 40-line grid rather than feature names. Game Info's maximum win of 850x is not an individual mini-slot multiplier.

features.title: Giant Symbols 2×2 and 3×3
features.description: Large symbols can occupy four or nine cells; placement on the first reel can immediately create a combination.

features.title: Bonus Slot
features.description: A Giant Bonus opens an additional mini-slot in its occupied area, awarding multipliers or Free Spins.

features.title: Pyramid Giant Wild
features.description: The large Wild substitutes for regular symbols except bonus symbols; a tomb-themed Gamble operates separately after a prize.

intro: Hot Dog Heist is a 5×3 slot with 40 paylines and seven different Free Spin modes. Individual dogs change the scenario: Golden Retriever awards Wild Reels, Rough Collie uses a sticky block, Labrador supplies an x5–x30 multiplier, and Border Collie provides Wilds and Re-Spins.

Pack Attack uses giant 4×4 Mega Symbols, while Bulldog holds two 2×2 symbols for additional Re-Spins. Who’s a Good Doggie is a pick-and-click bonus on 20 tiles, where cash prizes or one or more Free Spin modes can be found.
playn-go-hot-dog-heist.editorial: Hot Dog Heist cannot be reduced to one Free Spins template: its seven dog modes provide different Wild types, Mega Symbols, multipliers and re-spins. The pick bonus offers another way to combine several modes in one round.

features.title: Pack Attack and Golden Retriever
features.description: Pack Attack awards 4×4 Mega Symbols, while Golden Retriever turns reels into Wild Reels. These are different bonus scenarios.

features.title: Collie and Labrador
features.description: Rough Collie adds a sticky block, Labrador an x5–x30 multiplier, and Border Collie Wilds with Re-Spins.

features.title: Bulldog and Who’s a Good Doggie
features.description: Bulldog holds two 2×2 symbols for respins; the Who’s a Good Doggie pick bonus uses 20 tiles with cash prizes and bonus modes.

intro: Miami Beach uses five reels and twenty lines in a beach theme. The regular Wild has an x2 multiplier and helps complete winning combinations.
The Free Spins sequence combines Expanding Wilds with an Increasing Multiplier: during the bonus, a Wild can expand while the multiplier changes under the winning rules.
wazdan-miami-beach.editorial: Max Win 7200x refers to Miami Beach's whole mathematical model. Any Wild x2 appearance should not be treated as a guarantee of that result, nor should this bonus be transferred to Wazdan's fruit versions.

features.title: Beach Wild x2
features.description: The special symbol substitutes for regular symbols and doubles a win in which it participates.

features.title: Free Spins
features.description: The Scatter activates free spins, which the provider lists as a separate feature.

features.title: Growing multiplier and Expanding Wild
features.description: During the bonus, expanding Wilds combine with an Increasing Multiplier that is different from the fixed maximum win.

intro: Hotel Yeti-Way uses Dynamic Payways: the base 4,096 ways can grow to 262,144 when symbols split. Payway Multipliers are additionally active during Free Spins.

The bonus offers three themed functions: Bungee Jumping increases the chance of four Stacked Wilds, Surfing adds up to eight Wilds to the grid, and Scuba Diving makes Shark symbols sticky and awards additional Re-Spins.
playn-go-hotel-yeti-way.editorial: Hotel Yeti-Way grows its potential through Dynamic Payways geometry rather than fixed paylines. Its three Free Spins functions change Wild/Sticky states differently and should not be combined into one universal mechanic.

features.title: Dynamic Payways
features.description: Splitting symbols expand the base 4,096 ways to win to 262,144; Free Spins also use Payway Multipliers.

features.title: Bungee Jumping and Surfing
features.description: Bungee Jumping increases the chance of four Stacked Wilds, while Surfing adds up to eight Wild symbols to the grid.

features.title: Scuba Diving
features.description: Shark symbols become sticky and Scuba Diving adds Re-Spins—a different scenario from Stacked Wilds and Surfing.

intro: Midnight in Tokyo sends five reels with 243 ways to win into a neon Tokyo populated by samurai cats. Wild Splitters change the possibilities for forming combinations.
A separate Hold the Jackpot collects money values; Wild Splitters increase the number of ways rather than replacing the bonus round. The description mentions 243+ ways, while Game Info reports 243.
wazdan-midnight-in-tokyo.editorial: The plus sign in the marketing phrase ‘243+’ should not be equated with an infinite number of ways. The technical record fixes the count at 243, while the maximum win of 3000x refers to the full game.

features.title: Wild Splitters
features.description: Splitting Wilds expand combinations and the number of available paying ways.

features.title: Hold the Jackpot
features.description: The bonus mode separately accumulates Cash and jackpot values.

features.title: Buy Feature and Gamble
features.description: Wazdan lists bonus-feature purchase and a post-payout risk game; these are different interaction paths.

intro: House of Doom uses Hellgate: each spin highlights a random reel, and a Wild landing there expands across the whole reel. The House acts as a Scatter on reels 1, 3 and 5.

Three House Scatters trigger 10 Free Doom Spins; during the bonus, the House becomes a Wild House and can add extra spins. Separate Skulls of Abyss on reels 2–4 open a pick bonus with cash prizes or entry into Free Spins.
playn-go-house-of-doom.editorial: The first House of Doom ties its expanding Wild to one selected Hellgate reel, while its bonus branches are separate: Doom Spins operate through House Scatters, and Skulls of Abyss through a pick mechanic. These rules should not be carried into the sequel.

features.title: Hellgate and Expanding Wild
features.description: On every regular spin, a random reel becomes Hellgate. A Wild Seer landing there expands across the reel's full height.

features.title: House Scatters and Doom Spins
features.description: Three House Scatters on reels 1, 3 and 5 trigger ten Free Doom Spins. During the bonus, a Wild House can add new spins.

features.title: Skulls of Abyss
features.description: Three Skulls of Abyss on reels 2–4 open a separate pick game with money prizes or entry into Free Spins. This is not the Hellgate effect.

intro: Mighty Crown: Empire of Gold uses three reels and five lines. Three Bonus Symbols open Empire Bonus, where each bonus symbol becomes a Wild.
When Wilds occupy every position, individual values from x1 to x5 can add into a combined bonus multiplier up to x15. This differs from the whole game's maximum win of 1500x.
wazdan-mighty-crown-empire-of-gold.editorial: Empire of Gold focuses on Wild transformation during Empire Bonus, unlike Legacy of Mars, where the targets are crown Scatters and a full grid of sevens. Empire officially has very high volatility.

features.title: Three Bonus Symbols
features.description: Three special symbols trigger Empire Bonus and turn into Wilds.

features.title: Wilds in Empire Bonus
features.description: Every Bonus becomes a substituting symbol, changing the makeup of prize lines.

features.title: Up to x15 combined
features.description: When filling positions, Wilds award x1–x5 multipliers, totalling up to x15; Chance Level and Buy Feature affect the route to the bonus.

intro: House of Doom 2: The Crypt uses Spirit Gate. A random reel receives a special frame; a Wild inside becomes an Expanded Wild, covers the reel and triggers a Re-Spin.

Three spirits change these Re-Spins: Fire Mistress adds x2/x3/x5/x10 to wins, Metal Priestess upgrades symbols to Knives, and Queen of the Damned activates Spirit Gates on every reel. Three Scatters award 8 Free Spins, while upgraded Scatters open 8 Crypt Spins.
playn-go-house-of-doom-2-the-crypt.editorial: The sequel completely rebuilds its central mechanic around Spirit Gate. Crypt Spins adds a Spirit of Unity Wild and combines the three spirits' effects, so it is not a repeat of the first game's Hellgate/Doom Spins.

features.title: Spirit Gate and Re-Spin
features.description: A random reel is highlighted as Spirit Gate. A Wild within the frame expands across the reel's full height and triggers a re-spin.

features.title: Three spirits in Spirit Gate
features.description: Fire Mistress adds x2, x3, x5 or x10 multipliers; Metal Priestess turns symbols into Knives, while Queen of the Damned activates Spirit Gates on all reels at once.

features.title: Free Spins and Crypt Spins
features.description: Three Scatters trigger eight Free Spins; upgraded Scatters award eight Crypt Spins with a Spirit of Unity Wild and spirit effects. These rules are separate from original House of Doom.

intro: Legacy of Mars is a space-themed Mighty Crown version with five reels and ten lines. Scatter Respin holds a landed crown for the next spin.
Five crown Scatters or fifteen sevens across the whole grid trigger the Grand Jackpot worth 3000x. Two, three or four crowns award lower jackpot tiers.
wazdan-mighty-crown-legacy-of-mars.editorial: Legacy of Mars does not use Empire Bonus from three Wilds: its independent mechanic is a Scatter ladder and an alternative Grand route through all fifteen sevens.

features.title: Scatter Respin
features.description: A crown can lock for the next spin, increasing the chance of collecting the remaining Scatters.

features.title: Grand through two different conditions
features.description: Five crowns or a full grid of fifteen sevens open the top jackpot worth 3000x.

features.title: Chance Level x2/x5/x10
features.description: These multipliers increase bet cost for bonus probability rather than multiplying a prize already awarded.

intro: The original Hugo is a five-reel slot with up to 10 active lines. Treasure Chest Scatters on reels 1, 3 and 5 trigger Treasure bonus, where the player chooses mine doors and tries to reach the treasure chamber while avoiding Don Croco.

Three or more Afskylia Scatters trigger Free Spins with a choice of 5, 10 or 15 spins. Hugoline Extra Scatter pays x3, x2 or x1 the total bet respectively, while Hugo Wild doubles wins unless the combination consists only of Wilds.
playn-go-hugo.editorial: In Hugo, choosing Free Spins duration directly changes Extra Scatter value: fewer spins mean a higher multiplier. Treasure bonus remains a separate risk/pick branch rather than part of Free Spins.

features.title: Treasure Chests and mine doors
features.description: Treasure Chest Scatters on reels 1, 3 and 5 open a mine bonus: the player chooses doors on the way to treasure, trying to avoid Don Croco.

features.title: Afskylia Free Spins choice
features.description: Three or more Afskylia Scatters allow a choice of five, ten or fifteen Free Spins. The duration changes Hugoline Extra Scatter payout conditions.

features.title: Hugoline and Hugo Wild
features.description: Hugoline Extra Scatter pays x3, x2 or x1 the total bet with a choice of 5, 10 or 15 spins. Hugo Wild doubles wins unless the combination contains only Wilds.

intro: Mighty Fish: Blue Marlin builds its bonus around a fishing Cash Out rather than classic lines: Game Info lists five reels and zero lines.
Alongside regular Cash Out, Trawler Cash Out participates in value collection, while Collect to Infinity and Free Spins add separate accumulation methods.
wazdan-mighty-fish-blue-marlin.editorial: Blue Marlin differs from Mighty Wild: Gorilla through more than its character: it has two Cash Out varieties. RTP of 96.18%, very high volatility and a maximum of 2500x are confirmed directly by Wazdan.

features.title: Two Cash Outs
features.description: Regular Cash Out and Trawler Cash Out act as different ways to collect visible Cash values.

features.title: Collect to Infinity
features.description: Collectors retain a role in the accumulation bonus, affecting final collected amounts.

features.title: Free Spins and Chance Level
features.description: The Scatter opens a free-spin sequence, while Chance Level allows bonus chances to change through the bet.

intro: Hugo 2 takes the hero on a railway journey with 10 lines. Three Beaver symbols trigger a sequence of 10 Free Spins, while Beaver Cleaver allows retriggers up to a maximum of 20 consecutive spins.
During the journey, bags and coins can create extra Wilds and special symbols with additional multipliers. The bonus finale involves selecting a key to open a chest of gold.
playn-go-hugo-2.editorial: Hugo 2 does not repeat the original's 5/10/15-spin choice. Its bonus centres on Beaver Cleaver with a maximum of 20 Free Spins and a separate collectible track changing the Wild/special-symbol state.

features.title: Beaver Cleaver Free Spins
features.description: Three Beaver symbols trigger ten Free Spins. A retrigger can extend the sequence but never beyond twenty consecutive spins.

features.title: Journey items and Wilds
features.description: Along the railway, bags and coins can add extra Wilds and special symbols with additional bonus multipliers.

features.title: Choosing a chest key
features.description: A separate final adventure stage involves choosing a key to open a chest of gold. This is not the 5/10/15-spin duration choice from the first Hugo.

intro: Mighty Hot: 777 retains a retro fruit atmosphere on five reels, but Game Info lists ten ways to win rather than familiar lines.
The Scatter pays for three, four or five special symbols independently of lines. Filling the reels with matching-symbol walls makes the grid the main target for large payouts.
wazdan-mighty-hot-777.editorial: Mighty Hot has no confirmed Hold the Jackpot from Mighty Symbols: Sevens. The maximum payout of 2500x applies to the whole game, while a matching-symbol wall is not stated as a separate x2500 multiplier.

features.title: Five reels and ten ways
features.description: The official technical record says 5 / 10 Ways to Win rather than ten fixed lines.

features.title: Scatter 3/4/5
features.description: Three, four or five Scatters pay independently of regular combinations.

features.title: Seven and fruit walls
features.description: Large combinations form by filling whole reels with matching symbols; Gamble is available separately.

intro: Hugo Carts divides base-game functions among characters: Hugo on reel 3 adds 2–5 golden nugget Wilds, Scylla on reel 4 creates 5–9 Mystery Symbols, and other characters can add symbol multipliers up to x10.

Three, four or five Dynamite Scatters award 7, 9 or 11 Free Spins. A random character is chosen at the start, whose feature operates on every spin; retriggering through 3+ Scatters selects a new character until all three have been used.
playn-go-hugo-carts.editorial: Hugo Carts builds its bonus around changing character powers. A retrigger does more than add spins—it introduces another character, so progression is limited to a set of three different Free Spin features.

features.title: Hugo, Scylla and character powers
features.description: Hugo on the third reel adds two to five golden nugget Wilds. Scylla on the fourth creates five to nine Mystery Symbols; another character feature supplies symbol multipliers up to x10.

features.title: Dynamite Scatter and Free Spins
features.description: Three, four or five Dynamite Scatters trigger seven, nine or eleven free spins respectively. Don Croco can add Dynamite Scatters in the base game.

features.title: New characters on a retrigger
features.description: One random character is chosen when Free Spins starts. Three or more new Scatters select the next one until all three character features have been used.
